theorem bisimilarity_congr_choice :
    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  refine ⟨@ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h, ?_⟩
  intro s₁ s₂ hr μ
  cases hr with
  | bisim hb =>
    exact ⟨fun _ htr => (hb.follow_fst htr).imp fun _ h => ⟨h.1, ChoiceBisim.bisim h.2⟩,
           fun _ htr => (hb.follow_snd htr).imp fun _ h => ⟨h.1, ChoiceBisim.bisim h.2⟩⟩
  | choice hpq =>
    refine ⟨fun _ htr => ?_, fun _ htr => ?_⟩
    · cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        exact (hpq.follow_fst htr).imp fun _ h => ⟨Tr.choiceL h.1, ChoiceBisim.bisim h.2⟩
      | choiceR htr => exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceR htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩
    · cases htr with
      | choiceL htr =>
        exact (hpq.follow_snd htr).imp fun _ h => ⟨Tr.choiceL h.1, ChoiceBisim.bisim h.2⟩
      | choiceR htr => exact ⟨_, Tr.choiceR htr, ChoiceBisim.bisim (HomBisimilarity.refl _)⟩

    (p ~[lts (defs := defs)] q) → (choice p r) ~[lts (defs := defs)] (choice q r) := by
  intro h
  exists @ChoiceBisim _ _ defs, ChoiceBisim.choice h
  intro s₁ s₂ hr μ
  cases hr with
  | bisim hb =>
    exact ⟨fun _ htr => (hb.follow_fst htr).imp fun _ h => ⟨h.1, .bisim h.2⟩,
           fun _ htr => (hb.follow_snd htr).imp fun _ h => ⟨h.1, .bisim h.2⟩⟩
  | choice hpq =>
    unfold lts at *
    grind [ChoiceBisim, Bisimilarity.follow_fst, Bisimilarity.follow_snd]
